jobs.title: CLX Property Advocate, UK
jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
We're looking for a CLX Property Advocate to help our UK customers through some of the most stressful moments they'll face as policyholders. You'll join our Claims Experience team and own property claims from first report to resolution, keeping every interaction fast, fair, and caring. This role is remote, and you'll need to be online during UK working hours.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade : drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

•
Handle property claims end to end across email, phone, and chat.

•
Investigate and settle claims independently, keeping resolution times tight.

•
Own the complex and sensitive claims where judgment, empathy, and experience matter most.

•
Prioritize your daily caseload so no customer waits longer than they should.

•
Partner with fellow advocates to flag edge cases and shape how we handle them.

•
Spot patterns in recurring claim types and share them with the team to build smarter processes.

•
Keep our tone warm and human in every conversation, especially the hard ones.

What you'll need

•
Hands-on experience handling complex and large claims, preferably in property insurance

•
Working knowledge of UK consumer insurance rules, including the fair treatment of customers

•
Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain a complex claim simply

•
A customer-first mindset, plus the empathy and patience to stay steady when someone is stressed or frustrated

•
Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, and real curiosity about how AI tools can sharpen your work

•
A CII qualification, complex building claims experience, or time at a digital-first insurer (a bonus, not a must)

•
Ability to work in a remote environment

Role Description

As a Senior Full Stack Product Software Engineer on Dropbox ’s Web Developer Experience (Web DX) team, you will help design and develop the application platform, developer tooling, and shared foundations that enable engineers to build reliable web experiences. You will take ownership of key technical systems, designing scalable architectures and delivering improvements that make software easier to develop, test, and ship.

You will work closely with product and infrastructure engineering teams to improve build systems, language tooling, and development workflows. Your work will include accelerating TypeScript feedback, automating migrations, simplifying development environments, and evolving shared application foundations. As AI changes how software is built, you will help create the reliable builds, fast tests, and repeatable workflows that support engineers and coding agents.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here .

Responsibilities

• Deliver ongoing engineering impact through ownership of developer tooling, application foundations, and web-platform systemsImprove typechecking, builds, tests, and local development to shorten feedback loops and increase reliability

• Build automation for upgrades, code transformations, and migrations using repeatable validation and gradual rollout

• Collaborate with product and infrastructure teams to balance technical requirements, developer needs, and business goals

• Support the quality and operability of the systems you deliver through diagnostics, failure investigation, and agreed support arrangements

Requirements

• 9+ years of professional experience in full-stack development

• BS degree or higher in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience

You will take responsibility for developing and executing tailored onboarding plans and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience. • Help improve the French version of our platform and customer materials

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

• Full working proficiency in French and English; German is a plus

• Several years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success

jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures .

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram .

About the role

We are searching for an elite growth leader, ready to play the game of their career. You will be leading a passionate and highly motivated team of which in time will grow to 30+ reps across the Mesopotamia to a scale that very few businesses ever achieve, whilst having an impact on one of Argentina’s most vital industries, Agriculture.

Leading the Mesopotamia team, you will be covering the full customer cycle from new sales through to Account Management. We’re looking for someone with commercial nous, X-factor, charisma, highly competitive yet technically strong as a sales leader… and the ability to hit a target nobody can yet see possible. This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in leading the region's growth past the hundreds of millions of ARR. Roles of this scale, in a hyper-growth business, simply don’t come around often. Could be a bit of you?

You’ll be excited by exponential growth, and feel right at home leading on ambitious strategies. When the pressure is on in the biggest moments, you’ll be someone who wants to be in the game. You might find yourself juggling time on farm/ranch with customers, coaching and developing your team, through to driving growth strategy and cross-functional priorities within Halter. You’ll be masterful at building trusting relationships, driving sales processes, managing large pipelines and enabling a team, whilst advocating for customers with a solutions-oriented mindset.

Aside from jumping on the Halter roller coaster, you will be making a real world impact, making farming more productive and sustainable. You will build relationships across the provinces most influential farming leaders, who also happen to be some of the most down to earth, genuine humans you will ever meet. This is a high-stakes role, spearheading Halter’s growth in Mesopotamia.

Please submit your CV and application in English. This role works daily with teams in New Zealand, Australia and the US, so professional working English is essential.

Who we are looking for

•
Someone who doesn’t believe in glass ceilings and walks towards the pressure of large targets and thrives on hard problems.

•
Experience in growing new and existing businesses, developing market strategies and more importantly, a track record of delivering high growth.

•
Experience working with customers, navigating complex sales cycles and expanding value over time.

•
Strong ability to work cross-functionally and lead teams.

•
A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector would be a bonus.

•
A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges.

•
The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy.

•
A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team.

What your day could look like

•
Sales Leadership: Lead sales strategy, setting headcount requirements, regions and working closely with Halter leaders to form targets before laying that out to your team into an inspiring vision.

•
Manage your team’s inputs on a week to week basis, set the team’s cadence, set and track KPI’s and develop excellent pipeline hygiene.

•
Coach and develop your team to become better every week. Adapt Halter’s existing processes to develop and implement training programs for the Mesopotamia team, ensuring continuous skill enhancement and alignment with company objectives. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration within the sales organisation.

•
Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop the Mesopotamia team. Set clear performance expectations, KPIs and provide regular feedback. Lead on hiring and performance management. Foster a positive and collaborative team culture that promotes vulnerability and learning.

jobs.sourceName: Jobicy: latest jobs
jobs.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

About the Role: Binance Risk Operation team is seeking an experienced Risk Operations Specialist to implement effective risk control for the Binance platform and its users. You will be responsible for reviewing a range of predetermined alerts, as well as service requests, to determine whether recent account activity may be fraudulent in nature.

You will carry out investigations using multiple resources, including customer contact, reviewing account activity, assessing phone number matching, IP searches, and various online tools. Risk Operations Specialists are customer-focused and aim to enhance customers’ understanding of our account processes. At the same time, you will educate customers on maintaining account security and work to prevent losses for both the company and its users.

You will be responsible for reviewing documentation, analysing data, and making timely decisions on whether to verify the authenticity of transactions and/or activities. Throughout this process, you may need to communicate with customers to request additional information or to notify them of outcomes. A Risk Operations Specialist is organised, efficient, and motivated, demonstrates strong analytical skills, adapts well to change, and thrives in a collaborative team environment.

This position will operate in alignment with US time zone and requires shift-based operation, including potential weekends and public holidays.

What You’ll Do:

• Review and investigate risk-related cases, including KYC verification, account takeover concerns, two-factor authentication resets, withdrawal reviews, and abnormal trading activities (60%).

• Monitor account activity to detect unusual or suspicious behaviour and take appropriate action to prevent fraudulent or unauthorized transactions (15%).

• Contact account holders to verify account activity, investigate concerns, and mitigate potential losses (10%).

• Assess suspicious activities, identify potential risk indicators, and make timely, well-reasoned decisions in accordance with established procedures (10%).

• Maintain accurate and comprehensive case documentation to support auditability and quality assurance (5%)

What We’re Looking For:

• Minimum of 3–5 years of proven experience in high-risk, rule-based, or process-driven environments, preferably within financial services, fraud prevention, risk management, or compliance.

• Work independently with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of assigned cases and responsibility

• Flexible and willing to support weekend coverage as part of a team operating on a 7-day schedule.

• Hands-on experience conducting KYC (Know Your Customer), KYB (Know Your Business), account take over and transaction-related investigations.

• Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential risks within transaction data.

• Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well-supported case documentation and recommendations.

• Proven ability to make sound judgment calls and risk-based decisions in ambiguous situations while working with minimal supervision.

• Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail while performing effectively under pressure and managing competing priorities.

Why Binance

• Shape the future of finance

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

•
Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

•
Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

•
Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

•
Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

•
Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

•
Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

•
Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

•
Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

•
Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

•
Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

•
Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

•
Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

•
Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

•
AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

•
5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

•
Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

•
At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

•
A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

•
Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

•
Comfort working in a large, established codebase

•
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

•
Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

•
Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

•
High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

•
Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

•
Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

•
Temporal or another durable workflow engine

•
React Native

•
Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

•
Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

•
Open-source work or internal tools that other people use

If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool.

The VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) team builds and operates the core networking layer of our cloud platform. We enable virtual machines to communicate reliably by abstracting them from the underlying physical network, providing seamless IP-based connectivity even as workloads move across the datacenter.

Our team designs secure, isolated private networks for customers, connects them to the public internet, and delivers essential networking services such as load balancers, firewalls, and security groups. Because nearly every cloud application depends on networking, VPC is a foundational service for the entire platform.

Stability and resilience are our top priorities—we engineer systems to remain reliable and operational even when parts of the cloud experience failures.

Our team both develops the control-plane, written in Golang, and supports open-source based dataplane, written mostly in C. You own the company's identity provider: who signs in, from where, with which factors, into which applications — and how that access is granted, reviewed, and revoked.
Microsoft Entra ID is the primary identity plane and the center of gravity for the role. Google Workspace, Cloud Identity, and Google Cloud IAM form a secondary domain. Microsoft 365 is in scope for tenant, licensing, and access administration.
You are the escalation point for identity incidents from operations, security, service desk, and application teams — expected to resolve them, not route them onward.

What you'll own

Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365
– Users, dynamic and assigned groups, administrative units, directory roles, service principals, workload identities.
– Conditional Access design and rollout: named locations, client app and platform conditions, session controls, sign-in frequency, break-glass exclusions, report-only staging.
– Authentication methods policy and phishing-resistant factors.
– Application onboarding over SAML 2.0 (NameID, claims mapping, signing certificate rollover, encrypted assertions) and OIDC / OAuth 2.0 (authorization code with PKCE, client credentials, device code).
– App registrations: redirect URIs, permissions, admin consent workflow, secret and certificate lifecycle.
– SCIM 2.0 provisioning: attribute mappings, scoping filters, expression transformations, quarantined jobs, drift reconciliation.
– Tenant consent settings, OAuth grant review, remediation of over-permissioned and stale applications; defensible controls for SaaS without SSO or SCIM support.
– Joiner-mover-leaver as an automated pipeline: provisioning, group-based licensing, revocation with session and refresh token invalidation.
– Least privilege for admin access: scoped role assignments, RBAC, PIM, access reviews, entitlement management access packages.
– Service account and workload identity governance: ownership, credential rotation, permission scoping, decommissioning.
– Microsoft 365 tenant settings, licensing, admin roles; access and permission issues in Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Power Platform.
– Diagnostics from sign-in, audit, and provisioning logs, with diagnostic settings routed to Log Analytics and KQL queries.
– Cross-tenant access settings and B2B external collaboration.

Automation
– PowerShell tooling on the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK and Graph REST API: lifecycle, licensing, access reporting, recertification.
– Google-side automation through the Admin SDK Directory API, Cloud Identity API, and gcloud.
– Scheduled and event-driven workflows in Azure Automation Runbooks, Azure Logic Apps, or Power Automate.
– Unattended execution on managed identities and narrowly scoped app registrations, with credential rotation, structured logging, error handling, and retries.
– Automation treated as production code: version control, peer review, documented rollback.

What you'll bring

We care about what you can do, not which products appear on your CV. Concretely, you can:
– Decode a SAML assertion or JWT and pinpoint the failure — audience mismatch, NameID format, expired signing certificate, missing claim — without escalating to the vendor.
– Diagnose a failing SCIM job and tell scoping from attribute mapping, transformation expressions, or target schema.
– Replace a manual lifecycle process with automation that logs, retries, and can be handed to someone else to run.

Experience we expect

– 3+ years administering Microsoft Entra ID in production as a primary responsibility.
– Microsoft 365 tenant: settings, licensing, admin roles, Service Health
– Exchange Online: mailbox permissions, groups, mail flow, SPF/DKIM/DMARC
– Microsoft Defender: threat policies, quarantine, message trace
– Power Platform: environments, DLP connector policies, maker access
– PowerShell: Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph SDK
– Enterprise applications, app registrations, consent and permission models, automated provisioning.
– Azure Automation Runbooks, Azure Logic Apps, Power Automate, or comparable platforms.
– Least privilege, secure administration, change management, and the discipline to leave configurations documented.
– Written and spoken English at B2 or higher.

The work

• Calls are in US business hours (Eastern Time). The work is remote.

Who fits

• You are based in the United States.

• You have personally closed B2B service sales of US$5,000 or more with business owners or technical founders, on the phone.

• Experience selling to companies that pursue federal, SBIR or defense work is a strong plus.

• You are comfortable following a written call guide and firm rules: no promises about outcomes and no discounts.

• You do not currently write or sell federal proposal, white paper, SBIR or capture services for anyone else.

How we screen and what we pay

• Your written answers to the three questions below.

• Finalists record a 3 to 5 minute drill on a short script we send. The drill is paid: US$40.

• Every drill is scored on the same written scorecard.

• The strongest candidates are offered a paid two-week trial: US$45 an hour, up to 10 hours a week, plus 15% of the fees we actually collect on deals you close. The exact terms are in a written agreement you see before you start.

• The role after the trial depends on results. We do not promise a drill, a trial, a hire, or any number of hours, calls, deals or earnings. Call volume is modest today.

Part-time to start; the best performer moves to more hours as booked calls grow.

To apply, email these three answers. Everything is in writing.

• Describe one B2B service sale of US$5,000 or more that you personally closed: what the service was, the price, and who signed.

• Your city and state, and the hours you could work each week between 9 am and 6 pm Eastern Time.

• A prospect says, "Send me something and I'll think about it." What do you say next? Use your own words.

Job Title: Senior GTM Engineer

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.

We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.

Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY
At Salesloft, our Senior GTM Engineer is pivotal to turning signals into pipelines. You will be the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering team, reporting to the Director, Marketing Operations & GTM Engineering, with real ownership and a direct line to the people running the pipeline.

We just brought two companies together and rebuilt our CRM and marketing stack, and now we need someone who builds. You will own the systems that connect our data (Salesforce, Snowflake, Databricks) to action (Salesloft Rhythm, Marketo, LeanData), turn buying signals into plays reps actually run, and put AI agents to work on the busywork that slows marketing, sales, and CS down.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for building and running the GTM systems that drive the pipeline. Specifically, you will:

• Build and maintain integrations and workflows across Salesforce, Salesloft, Clari, Marketo, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, 1mind, and Tines.

• Write SQL and Python against Snowflake and Databricks to build signal logic, scoring, and data products.

• Turn usage, intent, job change, pipeline-trigger, and deal-health signals into Rhythm plays, and measure what they produce.

• Build and run AI agents and automations with logging, guardrails, and a named owner for each one.

• Keep data clean through deduplication, enrichment waterfalls, field governance, and routing hygiene.

• Partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.

• Document everything, so that if you’re out for two weeks, the system keeps running.

HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE (our values, in this role)

• Move as One: You’ll partner with Business Systems, Data & Analytics, and RevOps so what you build fits the platform instead of working around it.

• Evidence over Ego: You’ll measure what your plays produce and retire the signals that don’t perform.

• Lead from the Front: You’ll own the systems you build from launch through monitoring, with a named owner for each one, and document them so they keep running when you’re out.

• Make Your Mark: As the first dedicated GTM Engineer on the team, you’ll shape how we turn signals into pipelines and help hire the next GTM Engineer.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
You’re a bias-towards-action, results-oriented builder who ships production systems, explains them to a sales leader in plain English, and stays laser-focused on the pipeline. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.

YOU’LL BRING

• 5+ years building in GTM systems (RevOps, marketing ops, sales ops, or GTM engineering), with production builds you can walk us through.

• Strong SQL and working Python or JavaScript, and comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON.

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, plus at least two of: Marketo, LeanData, Salesloft or Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Snowflake.

• Experience with a workflow or iPaaS tool such as Tines, Tray, Workato, or n8n.

• You’ve shipped something with LLMs or agents that real people rely on every day.

• You can explain a build to a sales leader in plain English and tie it to the pipeline.

IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE

• Experience with dbt, reverse ETL (Census, Hightouch), or Databricks.

• Experience with Clay or ZoomInfo GTM Studio.

• You’ve been through a merger or a CRM migration.

This is a player-coach role. You will personally work through difficult product questions while developing a small, flat team of product managers and embedded product operations staff. Our bias is to build the simplest useful system and iterate quickly. You will recognize when engineers and operating owners can advance directly, where a PM can improve a defined outcome, and where substantial product or design discovery is needed.

As a Director of Product, you will:

• Build and develop the product team. Hire for the work, give direct feedback, coach research and measurement, and grow people’s judgment while keeping the structure proportionate to the team.

• Build a culture within product and engineering that values incremental progress toward measurable outcomes, clear stakeholder communication, and aggressive AI-forward productivity.

About the company

Taste Labs is building the data and infrastructure layer for taste.

Our goal is to end AI slop. To make AI feel right, not just be correct. We raised $18.5M in seed co-led by Amplify and CRV, and most frontier labs are already customers.

AI has nailed objective domains and can generate anything. The hard part left is judgement: what fits, what feels like you, what's actually GREAT. We're turning that into something measurable, starting with design.

We do it on two sides: building the post-training data and RL environments that teach taste to frontier models, and the context and verification tools agents need to produce work that's more creative, more on-brand, more right.

If that problem excites you, you'll like it here!

About this role

The TasteMakers community is at the core of what we do. Your role is to build the operating system, processing and check-ins for the community to run smooth. This is not a community management role, it's an ops one - you need to be a phenomenal operator who's great at turning things into machines, while being great with people.

DAY TO DAY

• You analyze the end to end funnel weekly, pull metrics and flag risks or areas of concern

• You run onboarding meetings and training with experts, you build training materials and create the process around it

• You run reactivation campaigns, engaging experts that have dropped off or not been active.

• You'll schedule sessions, email campaigns chase stalls, move experts through different steps in the funnel, answer questions, and more

• You'll run "bridging": the between project touchpoints to keep experts engaged and warm, so that retention stays high.

YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

• Are a doer, you know how to get stuff done. The goal is not just spotting problems, it's fixing them end to end. You need to be a true owner and not be afraid to get hands dirty.

• Are comfortable with ambiguity. We love process, but we won't always have answers for everything and need to start moving with imperfect information. You need to be comfortable navigating these scenarios while trying to bring structure.

• Are very organized, meticulous and detail oriented

• Love this mission and problem we're working on. This domain of "taste" and "design" is creative and subjective, and it's part of the fun of it.

WHERE YOU MIGHT COME FROM:
We are intentionally open. A handful of profiles match the shape of this work, none of which are obvious by title.

• Ops or production coordinators at design-first agencies, studios, or production companies

• Talent coordinators at agencies, casting operations, or fellowship and residency programs

Headquarters: Montreal, Quebec, Canada

URL: https://www.sweatpantsagency.com/

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

•

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

The US is our largest market, and we already have a strong customer base here. Now, we need to build a more focused, relationship-driven field marketing presence to drive our next phase of B2B growth. You’ll take the lead on shaping this approach from the ground up. Working closely with our US Sales and global marketing teams, you’ll design programs that engage enterprise decision-makers and strengthen strategic customer relationships. You’ll have the autonomy to prioritize target accounts and geographic markets, activating agencies and partners to scale your execution across the country.

Day to day, you will:

• Partner with Sales to map out target accounts, industries, and regional priorities, turning global strategies into focused US programs.

• Design and run executive roundtables, customer events, and industry programs that bring senior technology leaders together.

• Select and manage a network of agencies, event organizers, and partners to help execute your strategy across the US.

• Collaborate with global account-based marketing (ABM) teams to generate qualified leads and build meaningful business opportunities.

• Translate our broader narrative around agentic software development into relevant field initiatives that resonate with enterprise tech leaders.

What you’ll bring

• An entrepreneurial mindset. You are comfortable building programs from scratch and navigating ambiguity.

• A hands-on approach to your work. You take ownership of the strategy while also handling the details.

• Exceptional communication skills. You engage confidently with senior executives and stakeholders.

• A collaborative spirit. You build strong working relationships with global, cross-functional teams across different time zones.

• Deep industry insight. You understand exactly how software engineering organizations evaluate and adopt new technologies.

What you’ll need

• Proven success in US B2B field marketing, ideally within enterprise software or SaaS.

• A track record of attracting senior technology decision-makers to targeted events and account programs.

• Experience coordinating multiple external partners and agencies while maintaining strategic control.

What success looks like

In your first few months, you’ll establish strong alignment with US Sales and global marketing, identifying key regional priorities. Long-term, you’ll build a predictable, high-impact field marketing engine that deepens our relationships with enterprise decision-makers, generates qualified business opportunities, and establishes JetBrains as a trusted partner for AI-driven software development in the US.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

The Opportunity

Sezzle is building the next generation of consumer savings by connecting millions of engaged shoppers with exclusive offers from the world's leading consumer brands.

We're looking for an exceptional business development executive with deep relationships across the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry to establish Sezzle as a preferred strategic partner for brand-funded offers, discounts, cashback promotions, product launches, and shopper marketing initiatives.

This is a highly external, relationship-driven role. Success will be measured by your ability to open doors, build executive relationships, negotiate strategic partnerships, and develop a robust pipeline of compelling offers that create meaningful savings for Sezzle users while driving measurable sales for our brand partners.

Unlike many partnership roles, this position is focused primarily on originating opportunities—not managing existing accounts or operating a large internal organization. If you have spent years building trusted relationships across Fortune 500 CPG companies and love creating win-win commercial partnerships, we'd love to meet you.

Why This Role Matters

Sezzle reaches millions of highly engaged consumers during one of the most influential moments in commerce—the purchase decision.

Our payment platform, purchase insights, and growing consumer ecosystem create a unique opportunity for brands to influence shopping behavior, drive measurable incremental sales, and deliver exclusive savings directly to consumers.

You'll play a foundational role in building a new growth engine for Sezzle while helping consumers save money every day.

What You'll Do

Strategic Business Development (50%)

• Develop executive relationships with senior leaders across Fortune 500 CPG companies.

• Serve as Sezzle's primary ambassador within the CPG and shopper marketing ecosystem.

• Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that create value for consumers, brands, and Sezzle.

• Build and maintain a multi-year pipeline of strategic partnerships.

• Represent Sezzle at major industry events.

• Educate CPG executives on Sezzle's audience, purchase insights, and measurable outcomes.

• Identify emerging trends across shopper marketing, retail media, loyalty, and promotional marketing.

Partnership Development & Deal Execution (35%)

• Source and negotiate exclusive discounts, cashback offers, product launches, sampling campaigns, and promotional partnerships.

• Structure creative commercial agreements aligned with brand objectives and consumer value.

• Build long-term executive relationships leading to recurring marketing investments.

• Partner with retailers to unlock joint promotional opportunities.

• Lead commercial negotiations through contract execution.

• Collaborate with Legal and Finance on scalable partnership agreements.

• Develop case studies and success stories.

Cross-Functional Leadership (15%)

• Partner with Product on requested capabilities.

• Collaborate with Marketing on launches.

• Work with Data Science on measurement and ROI.

• Help shape the long-term roadmap.

• Recruit and mentor future partnership managers as the business scales.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

• 5+ years building commercial partnerships with Fortune 500 CPG companies.

• Demonstrated success originating and closing complex strategic partnerships.

• Existing executive relationships across leading CPG manufacturers.

• Deep understanding of shopper marketing, retail media, loyalty, and brand-funded marketing.

• Experience negotiating seven-figure commercial agreements.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

The Role

We’re hiring a Clinical Navigator (Licensed Practical Nurse) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM in the Pacific time zone.

What You’ll Do

• Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.

• Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.

• Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.

• Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.

• Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.

• Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.

• Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

Who You Are

• A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

• Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.

• Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.

• Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

• Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.

• Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

What You Need

• An active compact multi-state LPN/LVN license in the state where you currently reside is required.

• At least 5 years of clinical experience as a Licensed Practical Nurse is required.

• Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.

• An active CA state LVN license is required

• Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

• Experience providing patient ed

You will lead a talented team of product designers and design partners, work closely with Product and Engineering leadership, and bring a strong design point of view to company strategy and product decisions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can move comfortably between the strategic and the concrete: defining a coherent experience across a complex product, coaching designers through difficult problems, raising the quality bar, and ensuring the details hold up in the hands of real clinicians.

You will report to the Chief Product Officer and serve as a senior voice in the Product Development organization. The title and scope will be calibrated to the experience and demonstrated impact of the person we hire.

• Set and communicate a clear design vision for Elation’s product experience, grounded in our clinical-first principles and the realities of primary care.

• Build a high-performing Design function: clarify roles and responsibilities, establish effective operating rhythms, create growth paths, and hire and retain exceptional design talent.

• Partner with the CPO, product leaders, engineering leaders, and executive stakeholders to translate company strategy into a focused product experience strategy and roadmap.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, Targeting and advertiser-facing recommendations - converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while carefully balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

We are looking for an Applied Research Scientist II with a strong quantitative background to join our team. In this role, you will apply your expertise in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related field to help build and refine the algorithmic systems that power how Instacart's advertising marketplace operates. You'll work alongside a talented team of scientists and engineers, contributing to production systems that have real, measurable impact on a scaled ads platform. If you're excited by the intersection of rigorous quantitative thinking and large-scale engineering, this is the role for you.

About the Job

• Develop and evaluate models and algorithms for ads bidding, pacing, and budgeting, applying your training in operational research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline to solve complex marketplace problems at scale.

• Collaborate closely with senior scientists, engineers and product managers to translate well-defined marketplace questions into mathematical formulations, implement analyses and prototypes, design experiments, and interpret results using large-scale data.

• Contribute to production systems through algorithm implementation, validation, and monitoring, progressively taking ownership of well-scoped projects from initial hypothesis through measurable impact.

• Operate in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment where the ads marketplace shifts quickly — you'll need to balance rigor with speed, and thrive when priorities change and new challenges emerge.

• Communicate assumptions, findings, and limitations clearly to both technical and cross-functional partners, helping the team make better decisions through transparency and analytical clarity.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

• PhD in operations research, mathematics, statistics, economics, or a related quantitative discipline, with a strong foundation in at least one of the following areas: optimization, probability, statistical modeling, econometrics, or control theory.

• Proficiency in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to translate quantitative concepts into analyses, algorithm implementations, and experiments.

• Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain assumptions, methodologies, results, and limitations to both technical and cross-functional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• 2+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in applying quantitative methods to production systems.

• Familiarity with ads systems, auction theory, or related marketplace optimization problems.

• Experience working with large-scale data pipelines and real-time decision systems.

• Familiarity with machine learning techniques and applying machine learning in production systems.

jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, Germany

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business.

Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions.

The Bundeswehr is one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. With our Celonis for Defense & Security initiative, presented at the Munich Security Conference 2026, we offer a sovereign and trusted platform that integrates data across systems and optimizes military processes along the entire value chain. This means higher operational readiness through optimized logistics and faster maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) cycles, greater resilience through end-to-end supply chain transparency, and faster IT modernization by connecting existing systems with modern AI applications. Building on our data analysis solution Metropolis , we also help connect information from a wide range of sources into a comprehensive situational picture , enabling faster and better-informed decisions during the actual mission .

To drive this forward, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the Bundeswehr .

The Role:

This is not a typical Account Executive role. GrowthBricks brings that context together so agents and people can make decisions and execute effectively across the sales, marketing, and product stack.

GrowthBricks is a shared business brain for GTM teams and AI agents.

It brings together the context that usually lives across CRM, docs, dashboards, tools, and people’s heads: who we sell to, why customers buy, what matters now, what we tried, and what worked. Agents and people use that context to decide what to do next and execute across the GTM stack.

We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Tech Lead to build GrowthBricks from zero.

You’ll work directly with the product founder and own the technical side of the product: architecture, core systems, integrations, and the agent layer.

The core challenge is turning fragmented, changing business context into reliable memory and agent actions across tools and measuring whether those actions actually drive business outcomes.

You’ll write a lot of the early code yourself, make the key technical decisions, and shape the product as we learn what works.

What you’ll work on

• Connect GrowthBricks to the existing GTM stack rather than rebuilding everything around it.

• Understand how context, prompting, tools, and agent behavior fit together.

• Can design backend systems, APIs, data models, and integrations.

• Prefer simple, pragmatic solutions over unnecessary complexity.

• Have automated sales or marketing workflows, ideally with agents or LLMs.

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a world-class technology solution that creates an experience of delight and ease for physicians, and that our users love.

Every signed customer agreement at Elation passes through a final review before billing and onboarding begin. That review confirms what the customer signed matches what we set up in Salesforce: the right products, quantities, prices, and dates. When it's done well, customers get billed correctly from day one and our finance and customer success teams avoid costly cleanup later.We are looking for a Contract Operations Associate to join our Business Systems Team on a contract basis and own a share of these reviews. You'll work from clear checklists and procedures, use AI-assisted review tools, and partner closely with the specialists who own this process. This is a great fit for someone early in their career who is detail oriented, enjoys getting things exactly right, and wants hands-on exposure to how a SaaS company runs its revenue operations.

What You'll Do

Contract Review & Verification

• Own a daily review queue of signed deals awaiting final approval, starting with new customer agreements, downgrades, and simple add-ons (adding a product or seats), then expanding to renewals and other deal types as you ramp.

• Confirm the signed order form is complete : both the customer and Elation have signed and dated it, and you identify the official execution date.

• Check that key dates line up across the order form, the Salesforce opportunity, and the quote (execution date, close date, and contract start date), and that add-ons end on the same date as the customer's existing contract.

• Reconcile the quote against the order form line by line: products, quantities, terms, unit prices, and totals, including confirming that unchanged products and removed products are recorded correctly.

• Verify approvals and required data : discounts have a documented approval, required fields are filled in, and the customer account is a real, active practice rather than a trial.

• Correct routine issues directly in Salesforce (e.g., date fields or account details) when the procedure allows it, then advance the deal to Closed Won.

• Confirm downstream handoffs fired after approval, such as the customer's billing record and onboarding project being created, and flag anything that didn't.

Partnering with Sales & Customer Success on Corrections

• Return deals that need fixing to the account executive or customer success manager who owns them, with a clear, specific note: what doesn't match, where you found it (order form page, quote line, field), and what correct looks like.

• Follow corrections through to completion : track returned deals, check that the fix is right when they come back, and re-review promptly so customers aren't left waiting on billing or onboarding.

• Prioritize with deal owners during busy periods like month end, communicating which deals are blocked and what's needed to close them on time.

• Spot repeat issues by rep, team, or deal type and share them with the team, so we can improve training, Salesforce guardrails, and error messages and prevent the same mistake next time.

Resolving Open Questions with Stakeholders

• Bring questions to the right person with full context : the deal link, what you checked, what's unclear, and your best guess at the answer. Start with the team's operations specialist, then partner with Deal Desk, Customer Success leadership, Finance (billing and revenue reporting), or Salesforce administrators as directed.

• Escalate anything outside the checklist rather than making judgment calls on your own, such as contract exceptions, non-standard discounts, unusual date requests, or large and custom agreements.

• Track every open question until it's resolved , keeping the deal owner updated so nothing stalls silently in the queue.

• Capture the answer once a question is settled, adding it to the procedure or FAQ so the next reviewer doesn't have to ask again.

Tools, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

• Run AI-assisted review tools first on each deal, then complete the manual checklist and confirm or correct the tool's results; your corrections help improve the automation.

• Log issues and root causes in our ticketing system for any deal that didn't pass cleanly.

• Flag gaps or confusing steps in our procedures; your feedback directly shapes the documentation and training for future reviewers.

What You Bring

• Attention to detail : you notice when two documents don't match, and you double-check before calling something done.

• Process discipline : comfortable following a checklist exactly, every time, and keeping clean records of your work.

Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. Elation Health is searching for a Support Subject Matter Expert in Elation Billing — someone who has already done real medical billing and revenue cycle management work, not someone learning it on the job. • Serve as the Elation Billing product line's embedded RCM expert, owning complex billing and revenue cycle cases that require practitioner-level judgment — claims lifecycle issues, CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, payer adjudication and denial patterns, A/R and collections workflows.

• Act as the go-to resource for case swarms and escalations within Elation Billing whenever a Technical Support Specialist's investigation surfaces a billing nuance beyond scripted troubleshooting.

• Diagnose a practice's underlying billing context — payment model (insurance-taking vs. DPC), staffing structure, and prior workflow choices — to distinguish genuine product issues from configuration or workflow mismatches, rather than treating every case as a symptom in isolation.

• Partner with Product and Prod Dev, turning recurring billing edge cases, payer-specific patterns, and denial trends into structured feedback that can inform the roadmap.

• Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.

• Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.

• Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns rather than resolving the same root cause case-by-case indefinitely.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on medical billing / revenue cycle management experience — claims submission, payer follow-up, denial management, and A/R — brought in from outside a support organization, not built up through support tenure.

• Working fluency in CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, claims adjudication, and payer-specific billing rules across commercial and government payers.

• Experience working within an EHR, practice management, or medical billing platform (e.g., Epic, athenahealth, Waystar, or similar).

• Strong written and verbal communicator, able to translate complex billing and RCM concepts into clear guidance for both practices and internal teams.

• Self-directed and detail-oriented, with the judgment to know when a case needs to go beyond a scripted answer.

Preferred

• Prior experience supporting independent primary care or small-group practices specifically.

• Experience on a support, customer success, or implementation team at a SaaS/EHR company.

Headquarters: Karnataka, India

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/2NbDRiTU8do3haEgHLjLGC/jobs-at-lokal-app

Role - Video Editor
Work Location - Work From Home
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
About the role :
We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The role involves crafting short-form and mid-length video content such as social media reels, promos, and branded content. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact.
Key Responsibilities:
● Edit short-form and mid-length videos such as reels, social media ads, promos, and content explainers.
● Implement engaging hooks, dynamic pacing, and a strong narrative rhythm to maximize viewer retention.
● Tailor editing styles to suit platform-specific behaviors (e.g., fast cuts for Instagram, scroll-stopping openers for YouTube Shorts).
● Enhance video quality through thoughtful color grading, text animations, transitions, and immersive sound design.
● Collaborate closely with writers, designers, and creative leads to bring scripts and visual concepts to life.
● Stay updated on current editing trends, meme formats, cultural references, and audio trends to keep content fresh and relatable.
● Analyze ad performance metrics and apply learnings to improve edits for better click-through and completion rates.
● Edit videos in the required languages, ensuring linguistic accuracy, cultural relevance, and strong storytelling for the target audience.

What You’ll Bring
● 1–2 years of experience in video editing for social media or digital content.
● Proficiency in editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, or similar.
● Any Bachelor’s degree.
● Strong portfolio of short-form content (reels, ads, promos).
● Good understanding of social platform algorithms and engagement tactics.
● Strong storytelling instincts, visual creativity, and sound design skills.
● Language proficiency: Strong command over two languages minimum — English and TTMK— both written and spoken, to bring cultural nuance and flexibility in writing.
● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with tight deadlines
● Must bring their own laptop to perform day-to-day tasks.

Why This Role Is Exciting :
● Create high-impact video content that drives engagement and brand growth.
● Collaborate with cross-functional creative and marketing teams.
● Shape storytelling across platforms with visible, meaningful impact.

Why Join Us:
● Create impactful video content
● Competitive pay and growth opportunities
● Work with a creative, fast-moving team We’ll Get Alo

Ellipsis is fast becoming the market leader in "GEO" for B2B technology companies. This is a senior, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The move to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative and strategic in our approach. We started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, so this has been a time for us to thrive.

We think we understand AI search better than almost anyone. We have our own tracking product, ~25 million AI answers to analyze (with more tracked every week), and execution end-to-end: strategy, writing, in-house design, optimization, and performance reporting.

Marketing teams everywhere are working out what AI search means for them, and we're one of the few firms with credible answers backed by work we've already done. As Strategy Lead, you'll decide what work we do for every client, and why, and shape how our latest research on AI Search feeds into this decision. You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.

Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings <> implementation <> upskilling the team to ask better questions <> identifying gaps and new research.

Your job is to provide strategic judgement and ensure work gets done across the whole team. We have more data, tooling and ideas than any single client needs! jobs.title: Humbly Confident Marketing Lead
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Utah

URL: https://www.chirocat.com/

About Us and Why We're Hiring

We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.

The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!

We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.

That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.

What We're Looking For

REQUIREMENTS

For this role, you must:

•
Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)

•
Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us

•
Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you

•
Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts

•
Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow)

•
Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence

•
Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!

•
Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

These aren't required, but will help you stand out:

•
Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS

•
Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity

•
Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies

•
Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.

•
Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)

•
Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)

•
Comfort making short-form video

•
Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)

Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume.

Life at ChiroCat

ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.

HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT

Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.

Balanced Work, Balanced Life: We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.

Take Vacation (Seriously): Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler
